opportunities.name: JetBlue flight search by route and dates
opportunities.description: Search JetBlue flights for a given origin, destination, departure day and optional return day, then continue to the results page. Parameterised by origin city, destination city, trip type and travel dates.
steps: Click the 'From' textbox, type the origin city, and pick the matching suggestion.
Click the 'To' textbox, type the destination city, and pick the matching suggestion.
For a round trip, click the return date field and choose the return day; for one-way, select the One-way option first.
Click the departure date field and choose the departure day.
Click 'Search flights'.
Click 'Continue to flight results'.
Optionally open 'Sort & Filter' and set sort order or fare type on the results page.

instances.values: New York to Miami; depart day 27, return day 31 (month not shown in trace)
New York to Toronto; initially set to round trip on results page, then switched to one-way; depart day 29
Return Friday May 5, 2023 (origin and destination not in trace; sort and filter steps followed)

opportunities.name: United rental car search by pickup location, dates and times
opportunities.description: Search for a rental car on United's car page using a pickup city or airport, pickup and return dates, and pickup and drop-off times.
steps: Click the 'CAR' heading to open the car rental search.
Optionally tick 'Book with miles'.
Type the pickup city, airport name or code into the pickup location field and select the matching suggestion.
Click the 'Pickup' date textbox.
Click the pickup date in the calendar.
Click the return date in the calendar.
Open the pickup time combobox and choose a time.
Open the drop-off time combobox and choose a time.
Click 'Find cars button.'
parameters: pickup location (city, airport name or code)

instances.values: Pickup Caldwell; Sat Apr 8 to Thu Apr 13, 2023; pickup 8:00 a.m., drop-off 12:00 p.m.; book with miles on
Pickup Brooklyn - Central (New York); Sun Apr 9 to Sat Apr 15, 2023; times left at default

opportunities.name: Budget careers job search by country, team, time type and keyword
opportunities.description: Filter Budget's careers openings by country, team and employment type, optionally search by job title keyword, then open a posting and start the application.
steps: Click the 'Careers' link.
Click the 'Openings' link.
Open the Country filter and choose the country.
Open the Team filter, search for the team and pick it.
Open the Time Type filter, search for the employment type and pick it.
Click 'SEARCH BY JOB TITLE OR KEYWORD' and enter a keyword if needed.
Click the matching job posting link.
Click 'APPLY NOW'.

instances.values: Country United States of America; team Finance; time type Full time; keyword matched 'Accounts Payable Associate', APPLY NOW clicked
Country United States of America; team Finance; time type Full time; no posting opened

opportunities.name: NPS park search by activity or topic
opportunities.description: On nps.gov, open Find a Park, switch to Search by Activity or Topic, choose either Activity or Topic, enter a value and run the search.
steps: Click the 'FIND A PARK' link.
Click 'Search by Activity or Topic'.
Click the 'Activity' or 'Topic' button to choose the search type.
Click the search input and enter or pick the activity or topic.
Click the 'Search' button.

instances.values: Type Activity; value not captured in trace (input clicked, then Search)
Type Topic; value not captured in trace (input clicked, then Search)

opportunities.name: MTA bridges and tunnels toll lookup by vehicle type
opportunities.description: On the MTA site, navigate to Fares & Tolls, open Bridges & Tunnels tolls, pick a vehicle class and view the rates for a given crossing or payment method.
steps: Open the site menu or the 'Fares & Tolls' link.
Open 'Bridges & Tunnels' (or 'Bridges and Tunnels tolls').
Open 'Tolls by vehicle' or 'Toll Rates'.
Select the vehicle class (e.g. Cars or Motorcycles).
Select the payment method or open the specific crossing to read its rates.

instances.values: Agencies to Bridges & Tunnels, then Tolls by vehicle set to Cars
Fares & Tolls, Bridges and Tunnels tolls, Toll Rates, at a station booth, vehicle Motorcycles, crossing Bronx-Whitestone

opportunities.name: JetBlue hotel or vacation search by destination, dates and guests
opportunities.description: Search JetBlue vacations for a destination with check-in and check-out dates and a number of rooms and guests.
steps: Click the 'Search location' field, type the destination and pick the suggestion.
Open the date range picker and move between months if needed.
Click the check-in date and then the check-out date.
Open the rooms and guests selector and set the room and guest counts.
Run the search.
